verses.literal: [This is] the burden that Habakkuk the prophet received in a vision

verses.original: עַד־ אָ֧נָה יְהוָ֛ה שִׁוַּ֖עְתִּי וְלֹ֣א תִשְׁמָ֑ע אֶזְעַ֥ק אֵלֶ֛יךָ חָמָ֖ס וְלֹ֥א תוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘aḏ- ’ā·nāh Yah·weh šiw·wa‘·tî wə·lō ṯiš·mā‘ ’ez·‘aq ’ê·le·ḵā ḥā·mās wə·lō ṯō·wō·šî·a‘
verses.literal: How long . . . O LORD must I call for help but You do not hear or cry out to You Violence but You do not save

verses.original: לָ֣מָּה תַרְאֵ֤נִי אָ֙וֶן֙ תַּבִּ֔יט וְעָמָ֣ל וְשֹׁ֥ד וְחָמָ֖ס לְנֶגְדִּ֑י רִ֦יב וַיְהִ֧י וּמָד֖וֹן יִשָּֽׂא׃
verses.transliteration: lām·māh ṯar·’ê·nî ’ā·wen tab·bîṭ wə·‘ā·māl wə·šōḏ wə·ḥā·mās lə·neḡ·dî rîḇ way·hî ū·mā·ḏō·wn yiś·śā
verses.literal: Why do You make me see iniquity Why do You tolerate wrongdoing Destruction and violence [are] before me Strife is ongoing and conflict abounds

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּן֙ תּוֹרָ֔ה תָּפ֣וּג מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וְלֹֽא־ לָנֶ֖צַח יֵצֵ֥א כִּ֤י רָשָׁע֙ מַכְתִּ֣יר אֶת־ הַצַּדִּ֔יק עַל־ כֵּ֛ן מִשְׁפָּ֖ט יֵצֵ֥א מְעֻקָּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên tō·w·rāh tā·p̄ūḡ miš·pāṭ wə·lō- lā·ne·ṣaḥ yê·ṣê kî rā·šā‘ maḵ·tîr ’eṯ- haṣ·ṣad·dîq ‘al- kên miš·pāṭ yê·ṣê mə·‘uq·qāl
verses.literal: Therefore . . . the law is paralyzed and justice never . . . goes forth For the wicked hem in - the righteous so that . . . justice is perverted

verses.original: רְא֤וּ בַגּוֹיִם֙ וְֽהַבִּ֔יטוּ וְהִֽתַּמְּה֖וּ תְּמָ֑הוּ כִּי־ פֹּעֵ֣ל פֹ֙עַל֙ בִּֽימֵיכֶ֔ם לֹ֥א תַאֲמִ֖ינוּ כִּ֥י יְסֻפָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: rə·’ū ḇag·gō·w·yim wə·hab·bî·ṭū wə·hit·tam·mə·hū tə·mā·hū kî- pō·‘êl p̄ō·‘al bî·mê·ḵem lō ṯa·’ă·mî·nū kî yə·sup·pār
verses.literal: Look at the nations and observe be utterly astounded . . . For [I am] doing a work in your days that you would never believe even if [someone] told you

verses.original: כִּֽי־ הִנְנִ֤י מֵקִים֙ אֶת־ הַכַּשְׂדִּ֔ים הַמַּ֣ר וְהַנִּמְהָ֑ר הַגּ֖וֹי הַֽהוֹלֵךְ֙ לְמֶרְחֲבֵי־ אֶ֔רֶץ לָרֶ֖שֶׁת מִשְׁכָּנ֥וֹת לֹּא־ לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- hin·nî mê·qîm ’eṯ- hak·kaś·dîm ham·mar wə·han·nim·hār hag·gō·w ha·hō·w·lêḵ lə·mer·ḥă·ḇê- ’e·reṣ lā·re·šeṯ miš·kā·nō·wṯ lō- lōw
verses.literal: For behold I am raising up - the Chaldeans that ruthless and impetuous nation which marches through the breadth of the earth to seize dwellings not their own

verses.original: ה֑וּא אָיֹ֥ם וְנוֹרָ֖א מִמֶּ֕נּוּ יֵצֵֽא׃ מִשְׁפָּט֥וֹ וּשְׂאֵת֖וֹ
verses.transliteration: hū ’ā·yōm wə·nō·w·rā mim·men·nū yê·ṣê miš·pā·ṭōw ū·śə·’ê·ṯōw
verses.literal: They are dreaded and feared from themselves they derive justice and sovereignty

verses.original: סוּסָ֗יו וְקַלּ֨וּ מִנְּמֵרִ֜ים וְחַדּוּ֙ מִזְּאֵ֣בֵי עֶ֔רֶב פָּֽרָשָׁ֑יו וּפָ֖שׁוּ וּפָֽרָשָׁיו֙ יָבֹ֔אוּ מֵרָח֣וֹק יָעֻ֕פוּ כְּנֶ֖שֶׁר חָ֥שׁ לֶאֱכֽוֹל׃
verses.transliteration: sū·sāw wə·qal·lū min·nə·mê·rîm wə·ḥad·dū miz·zə·’ê·ḇê ‘e·reḇ pā·rā·šāw ū·p̄ā·šū ū·p̄ā·rā·šāw yā·ḇō·’ū mê·rā·ḥō·wq yā·‘u·p̄ū kə·ne·šer ḥāš le·’ĕ·ḵō·wl
verses.literal: Their horses are swifter than leopards fiercer than wolves of the night Their horsemen charge ahead and their cavalry comes from afar They fly like a vulture swooping down to devour

verses.original: כֻּלֹּה֙ יָב֔וֹא מְגַמַּ֥ת לְחָמָ֣ס פְּנֵיהֶ֖ם קָדִ֑ימָה וַיֶּאֱסֹ֥ף שֶֽׁבִי׃ כַּח֖וֹל
verses.transliteration: kul·lōh yā·ḇō·w mə·ḡam·maṯ lə·ḥā·mās pə·nê·hem qā·ḏî·māh way·ye·’ĕ·sōp̄ še·ḇî ka·ḥō·wl
verses.literal: All of them come bent on violence their hordes [advance like] the east [wind] they gather prisoners like sand

verses.original: וְהוּא֙ יִתְקַלָּ֔ס בַּמְּלָכִ֣ים וְרֹזְנִ֖ים מִשְׂחָ֣ק ל֑וֹ ה֚וּא יִשְׂחָ֔ק לְכָל־ מִבְצָ֣ר וַיִּצְבֹּ֥ר עָפָ֖ר וַֽיִּלְכְּדָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hū yiṯ·qal·lās bam·mə·lā·ḵîm wə·rō·zə·nîm miś·ḥāq lōw hū yiś·ḥāq lə·ḵāl miḇ·ṣār way·yiṣ·bōr ‘ā·p̄ār way·yil·kə·ḏāh
verses.literal: They scoff at kings and {make} rulers an object of scorn They laugh at every fortress and build up siege ramps to seize it

verses.original: אָ֣ז חָלַ֥ף ר֛וּחַ וַֽיַּעֲבֹ֖ר ז֥וּ וְאָשֵׁ֑ם כֹח֖וֹ לֵאלֹהֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’āz ḥā·lap̄ rū·aḥ way·ya·‘ă·ḇōr zū wə·’ā·šêm ḵō·ḥōw lê·lō·hōw
verses.literal: Then they sweep by like the wind and pass through They are guilty their own strength is their god

verses.original: אַתָּ֣ה הֲל֧וֹא מִקֶּ֗דֶם יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהַ֛י קְדֹשִׁ֖י לֹ֣א נָמ֑וּת יְהוָה֙ שַׂמְתּ֔וֹ לְמִשְׁפָּ֣ט וְצ֖וּר יְסַדְתּֽוֹ׃ לְהוֹכִ֥יחַ
verses.transliteration: ’at·tāh hă·lō·w miq·qe·ḏem Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hay qə·ḏō·šî lō nā·mūṯ Yah·weh śam·tōw lə·miš·pāṭ wə·ṣūr yə·saḏ·tōw lə·hō·w·ḵî·aḥ
verses.literal: Are You not from everlasting O LORD my God my Holy One vvv We will not die O LORD You have appointed them to execute judgment O Rock You have established them for correction

verses.original: עֵינַ֙יִם֙ טְה֤וֹר מֵרְא֣וֹת רָ֔ע לֹ֣א תוּכָ֑ל וְהַבִּ֥יט אֶל־ עָמָ֖ל לָ֤מָּה תַבִּיט֙ בּֽוֹגְדִ֔ים תַּחֲרִ֕ישׁ רָשָׁ֖ע בְּבַלַּ֥ע צַדִּ֥יק מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ê·na·yim ṭə·hō·wr mê·rə·’ō·wṯ rā‘ lō ṯū·ḵāl wə·hab·bîṭ ’el- ‘ā·māl lām·māh ṯab·bîṭ bō·wḡ·ḏîm ta·ḥă·rîš rā·šā‘ bə·ḇal·la‘ ṣad·dîq mim·men·nū
verses.literal: Your eyes are too pure to look upon evil and You cannot . . . tolerate . . . wrongdoing So why do You tolerate the faithless Why are You silent while the wicked swallow up those more righteous than themselves

verses.original: וַתַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אָדָ֖ם כִּדְגֵ֣י הַיָּ֑ם כְּרֶ֖מֶשׂ לֹא־ מֹשֵׁ֥ל בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·ta·‘ă·śeh ’ā·ḏām kiḏ·ḡê hay·yām kə·re·meś lō- mō·šêl bōw
verses.literal: You have made men like the fish of the sea like creeping things [that have] no ruler

verses.original: כֻּלֹּה֙ הֵֽעֲלָ֔ה בְּחַכָּ֣ה יְגֹרֵ֣הוּ בְחֶרְמ֔וֹ וְיַאַסְפֵ֖הוּ בְּמִכְמַרְתּ֑וֹ עַל־ כֵּ֖ן יִשְׂמַ֥ח וְיָגִֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: kul·lōh hê·‘ă·lāh bə·ḥak·kāh yə·ḡō·rê·hū ḇə·ḥer·mōw wə·ya·’as·p̄ê·hū bə·miḵ·mar·tōw ‘al- kên yiś·maḥ wə·yā·ḡîl
verses.literal: [The foe] pulls all of them up with a hook he catches them in his dragnet and gathers them in his fishing net so . . . he rejoices gladly . . .

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּן֙ יְזַבֵּ֣חַ לְחֶרְמ֔וֹ וִֽיקַטֵּ֖ר לְמִכְמַרְתּ֑וֹ כִּ֤י בָהֵ֙מָּה֙ חֶלְק֔וֹ שָׁמֵ֣ן וּמַאֲכָל֖וֹ בְּרִאָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên yə·zab·bê·aḥ lə·ḥer·mōw wî·qaṭ·ṭêr lə·miḵ·mar·tōw kî ḇā·hêm·māh ḥel·qōw šā·mên ū·ma·’ă·ḵā·lōw bə·ri·’āh
verses.literal: Therefore . . . he sacrifices to his dragnet and burns incense to his fishing net for by these things his portion is sumptuous and his food is rich

verses.original: הַ֥עַל כֵּ֖ן יָרִ֣יק חֶרְמ֑וֹ וְתָמִ֛יד לַהֲרֹ֥ג גּוֹיִ֖ם לֹ֥א יַחְמֽוֹל׃ס
verses.transliteration: ha·‘al kên yā·rîq ḥer·mōw wə·ṯā·mîḏ la·hă·rōḡ gō·w·yim lō yaḥ·mō·wl
verses.literal: Will he therefore empty his net and continue to slay nations without mercy
